Okay, I can help you with a prompt for a simple Instagram poster for your shop, Chai Junction, in Vijay Nagar, Indore. You want to use a real shop photo and avoid fake offers or prices.

Here is a prompt you can use for an Instagram poster, based on the "Offer and Festival Posters" lesson (Lesson 05) from the AI Local Business Ads course:

```
Use this photo of our shop as the main image. Turn it into a clean, modern poster for Instagram for our shop. Keep the shop exactly as it is in the photo — do not add or change anything in the shop.
Write ONLY this text, spelled exactly like this, nothing else:
- Top, big bold: "CHAI JUNCTION"
- Below it: "Chai, Maggi, Sandwiches"
- Bottom: "Vijay Nagar · Indore"
Warm colours, easy-to-read bold fonts, clean layout with the shop clearly visible. Do not add any other words, discounts, percentages, logos or claims.
```

This prompt will help you create a poster that highlights your shop name and what you sell, using your actual shop photo, without adding any offers or prices.
